model.form: w = exp(sum_k beta_k z_k); value = pixel_radiance * w / area_weighted_mean(w) within the assigned pixel
model.normalisation: area-weighted pixel mean preserved over the cells assigned to each pixel
model.dominant_pixel_rule: cell assigned to the valid NASA pixel with the largest overlap area; pixel_id breaks ties

scale_transfer.description: aggregate full 3x3 pixels to ~1.4 km, redistribute to 463 m, compare with observed 463 m

validation.adoption_criterion: scale-transfer MAE improves versus L0 in >= 4/5 spatial folds and S-DoT rank correlation does not degrade

provenance.nasa: NASA Black Marble VNP46A3 2026-09, Mandatory_Quality_Flag 0/1 only
provenance.sdot: 서울 S-DoT 2026-10-12~18, night hours 22-01, light_* flags excluded, 0 lux kept
